hero.title: Chandragupta Maurya: Empire Builder
hero.description: Founder of the Mauryan dynasty who unified India under a centralized administration with the guidance of Chanakya.

cards.details: Chandragupta overthrows Dhana Nanda to establish the Mauryan Empire.
Conflict with Seleucus Nicator, resulting in the eastern satrapies ceding to Chandragupta.
Abdication of the throne and migration to Shravanabelagola for Sallekhana.

traps.title: UPSC Common Exam Traps
items: Do not confuse Chandragupta Maurya with Chandragupta I (Gupta Dynasty); they are separated by 600 years.
Avoid the misconception that he founded the empire alone; the role of Kautilya (Chanakya) as an advisor is historically central to statecraft.

sections.title: 1. Core Study Notes
sections.content:
Geography

  • Unified Northern India
  • Control over Arachosia (Kandahar)
  • Capital: Pataliputra

Personalities

  • Chanakya (Advisor)
  • Seleucus Nicator (Rival)
  • Megasthenes (Ambassador)

Administrative Hierarchy

  • Centralized Bureaucracy: Mentioned in Arthashastra as 'Tirthas' (18 departments).
  • Espionage System: Elaborate 'Gudha-purushas' network for internal security.
  • Municipal Administration: Six committees of five members each (per Megasthenes).
